original: Do not be fooled by the darkness in your heart! Calm yourself!
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
The lines you continue to spew make me sick。。。! The entire reason that I desired power and was consumed by darkness was because you、 Sister Alouette。。。!
Sister Alouette caused this。。。?
Not only have my dreams of becoming the Maiden of Light been crushed、 but you also plan on protecting Sister Alouette and fighting Croix?
You could never do such a thing! Because I want to save Croix!
